# Mélange Digital

> Mélange Digital is a travel and tourism marketing agency — turning cultural insight into measurable arrivals for tourism boards, DMOs, NTOs, and travel brands. The agency combines destination storytelling, creator campaigns, branded content, experiential marketing, and travel PR across India and global markets.

## Company
- [Homepage](https://melangedigital.co/): Travel and tourism marketing agency overview, campaign outcomes, and destination expertise.
- [About](https://melangedigital.co/about): Agency background and leadership.
- [Services](https://melangedigital.co/services): Overview of services for tourism boards and travel brands.
- [Influencer & Celebrity Marketing](https://melangedigital.co/services/influencer-marketing): Creator and celebrity campaigns for travel and tourism.
- [Branded Content & IPs](https://melangedigital.co/services/branded-content-ips): Film, music, and editorial partnerships that connect destinations with audiences.
- [Experiential Marketing](https://melangedigital.co/services/experiential-marketing): Trade shows, roadshows, destination launches, and live activations.
- [FAM Trips + PR](https://melangedigital.co/services/fam-trips-pr): Familiarisation trips, destination PR, journalist and creator hosting, and travel trade engagement.
- [Contact](https://melangedigital.co/contact): Contact the team and schedule a strategy call.

## Selected Case Studies
- [Resorts World Cruises](https://melangedigital.co/work/resorts-world-cruises-premium-cruise-launch-dubai): GCC market launch that generated $2.3M in attributed sales across three audiences and three languages.
- [Costa Cruises](https://melangedigital.co/work/costa-cruises-introducing-luxury-cruising-to-india): Maiden-voyage campaign that generated more than 9,000 qualified enquiries.
- [Singapore Tourism Board](https://melangedigital.co/work/singapore-tourism-board-isthisevensingapore): Tourism campaign reaching Indian families through creators and AR filters.
- [Her Hong Kong](https://melangedigital.co/work/hong-kong-tourism-board-herhongkong): Influencer-led Hong Kong destination campaign.
- [Zambia Tourism](https://melangedigital.co/work/zambia-tourism-otm-mumbai-2026): Tourism destination campaign and visitor engagement.
- [All case studies](https://melangedigital.co/work): Browse the work portfolio.
